name: FSQ WAA Edge Eval
description: Run three original WAA Edge settings tasks through FSQ Windows UI in fresh private Profiles, then score independently and retain screenshot evidence.

variables.name: git-url
variables.description: Remote GitHub source repository. Cloned once into a dedicated cache; fetched before every new Task.

variables.name: git-branch
variables.description: Remote branch whose latest commit is fetched and recorded. Does not install that source into fsq-python.

variables.name: fsq-python
variables.description: Absolute python.exe path of the installed FSQ environment.

variables.name: dataset-dir
variables.description: Absolute path to the original WAA examples\msedge directory on the executing Machine.

variables.name: edge-exe
variables.description: Optional Edge executable path. Omit to discover the standard Windows installation.

variables.name: case-ids
variables.description: Optional comma-separated task IDs. Omit for profile name, font size, and download folder. Other tasks are not yet adapted.
